payload.title: Build the offline unified flywheel harness (arms 0, A, B-local, B, A+B)
payload.description:
## Purpose

Offline harness for arms 0 / A / B-local / B / A+B.

## Done

Commit eb6927f (`feat: offline harness for the unified flywheel`): `unified_loop`, `unified_spend` (durable request ceiling, failure breaker), `unified_splits`, `unified_stats`, `unified_knn`, fake Jev, leakage guards, text-free outputs, live mode off by default; specs beside each module. Commit 85cbb32 lets `gpt-6` analysts run (`max_completion_tokens`, no default temperature). Released as 0.10.0 / 0.10.1.
